projects.title: Production ML Systems (Deployed)
projects.description: Led team of 3 engineers developing automated price intelligence system with multimodal AI; built product matching using Google SigCLIP (text + image embeddings with category-specific weighting) to match 6,000 SKUs across 6 retailers. Deployed to production on GCP (Vertex AI), running 2+ years; integrated with BigQuery for real-time analytics dashboards.

projects.title: Analytics Platform (Production)
projects.description: Contributed as team member (7-person team) to large-scale analytics platform deployed to production for Vietnam's largest supermarket chain (Kingfood/Onelife). Optimized BigQuery pipelines handling millions of daily transactions; built production dashboards with FastAPI backend.

projects.title: ML Infrastructure & Pipelines
projects.description: Designed and automated ML pipelines on Google Vertex AI with orchestration using Airflow. Implemented CI/CD practices with GitLab CI for automated model training and deployment. Deployed FastAPI-based ML services; containerized models with Docker for reproducible deployments. Built monitoring infrastructure tracking model performance.

projects.title: Computer Vision - Fashion Detection System
projects.description: Led team of 3 engineers developing fashion detection system (RetinaNet, 92% AP, 19 categories) for 2 years. Evaluated YOLO/ResNet before selecting RetinaNet for production. Implemented complete CV pipeline from data preprocessing to inference.

projects.title: NLP & Forecasting Systems
projects.description: Designed NLP systems: Vietnamese recipe chatbot using RAG with 800 recipes; personalized notification system using LoRA fine-tuning on Llama 3. Built demand forecasting models (DeepAR, LightGBM) for time-series sales prediction at store and regional levels.
